m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md) and the handoff + named source files (grip_store.py, session_race.py, tyre_supplant.py, student_t.py, schema.sql). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context + handoff loaded; handoff complete; source files read

m1.title: Vectorized cumulative-track-laps helper + regression test
m1.imperative: Create src/physics/layer2/grip_baseline.py with a single-SQL-query vectorized per-session cumulative-track-laps helper matching compute_cumulative_track_laps EXACTLY (COUNT of lap_times rows with lap_number < X, all cars, ignoring valid_lap/track_status). Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_grip_baseline.py with a regression test comparing the vectorized output to compute_cumulative_track_laps on real (session_id,lap_number) pairs from data/f1_data_2023.db. They must match exactly.

postconditions.statement: cumulative helper matches compute_cumulative_track_laps on real 2023 data

m2.title: Generalized session-type reader + saturating-curve core fit (predictive_t)
m2.imperative: Add a local session_type-generalized clean-lap reader (mirrors _read_clean_race_laps, parameterized session_type) and the saturating-curve + free-offset core fit. Feed reader output to race_degradation_slopes UNCHANGED for the tyre-supplant wear correction. Fit grip = offset + asymptote*(1-exp(-rate*cum_laps)) on the corrected pace; derive all GripEstimateRecord fields (curve_asymptote/rate/session_offset + sigmas via predictive_t, curve_offset_correlation from the fit covariance). Test a synthetic normal session produces fit_status='ok' and all fields.

postconditions.statement: normal-fit synthetic session yields ok record with all curve fields and predictive_t sigmas

constraints: generalized reader local to grip_baseline.py (do not edit tyre_supplant.py)

m3.title: Thin-session wide-sigma fallback (frozen)
m3.imperative: Implement the frozen thin-session rule: normal fit only if >=2 usable driver-stints of >=MIN_STINT_LAPS(4) laps. Below floor: never drop; estimate session_offset via within-weekend nearest-neighbor extrapolation (nearest normal-fit session's curve evaluated at this session's cumulative position), sigma inflated by named THIN_SESSION_SIGMA_INFLATION; fit_status='thin_fallback', fallback_reason set. All-thin degenerate -> field-wide prior (no crash). Test a 2-lap-stint fixture yields thin_fallback with inflated sigma, non-null record.

postconditions.statement: 2-lap-stint fixture -> thin_fallback, inflated sigma, never dropped/NULL

constraints: frozen: floor=2 stints of 4 laps, wide-sigma fallback, never drop the record

m4.title: Rain-flag re-estimation (frozen Mission requirement)
m4.imperative: Decode sessions.rainfall (little-endian int64 wet-sample count) to a rain flag (count>0). When rain, re-estimate the offset fit with a SEPARATE named constant RAIN_SIGMA_INFLATION widening session_offset_sigma vs the equivalent dry fit. Real tested effect. Test asserts rain-fit session_offset_sigma is numerically wider than the dry-fit sigma on identical data.

postconditions.statement: rain-fit session_offset_sigma demonstrably > dry-fit sigma (direct numeric compare)

constraints: frozen Mission requirement: real tested sigma effect, separate named constant from thin

m5.title: DB-facing wrapper end-to-end + full suite + simplification gate
m5.imperative: Add the DB-facing fit_session_grip_baseline wrapper (reads laps + rainfall from db_path, assembles a GripEstimateRecord, error_record on failure). Smoke-test it end-to-end on a real 2023 session. Run the FULL test file green, then run simplification_limits on both new files and address findings.

postconditions.statement: simplification_limits passes on both new files

why_trail.why: handoff complete (all sections present); grip_store/session_race/tyre_supplant/student_t/schema read; rain col decoded (int64 wet-count)
vectorized cumulative helper = single GROUP BY + exclusive prefix sum; matches compute_cumulative_track_laps exactly on 3 real 2023 R sessions

generalized reader parameterizes session_type; race_degradation_slopes reused unchanged for wear correction; curve_fit saturating form; sigmas via predictive_t(nu_loss=DEFAULT_NU_LOSS,FormulaRule,n_eff=n_stints); curve_offset_correlation=corr(asymptote,offset) from pcov
thin floor=2 stints of 4 laps; below->nearest-normal-neighbor curve at this cum, sigma*3.0; all-thin->field prior on own-mean pace, wide sigma; record never dropped
rainfall int64 blob decoded (count>0=rain); rain widens session_offset_sigma by RAIN_SIGMA_INFLATION=4.0 (dry 0.0296 -> rain 0.1184, factor 4.000); mean unchanged; composes with thin
DB wrapper fits real 2023 Bahrain(dry)/Netherlands(wet) end-to-end; full suite 12/12 green; simplification_limits PASS on both files
